name: Bison Lacrosse Club
title: Club Lacrosse Team | Bison Lacrosse Club
inspection: Welcome to Bison Lacrosse! We strive to build an inclusive lacrosse community northeast of Denver. Communities served have included Commerce City, Brighton, Lochbuie, Thornton, and Northglenn. As our area and the sport of lacrosse continues to grow, we believe it is our responsibility to provide this opportunity to the youth in our community. Our goal is to grow the sport of lacrosse by offering an encouraging environment for players who have never picked up a stick to more advanced players who want to grow as a player and as a person.

Club volleyball is organized, competitive volleyball played outside the school system. Players join a club, try out for a team, and compete in tournaments through the season, all sanctioned by USA Volleyball (USAV) and, here in Colorado, the Rocky Mountain Region (RMR).
